## Bounded Operators

Let $H$ be a Hilbert space over $\C$. Recall our global macro test: $x \in \R^n$ and $\inner{u}{v}$.

::: {#def-spectrum}
## Spectrum

Let $T \in \End(H)$. The **spectrum** of $T$, denoted $\Spec(T)$, is the set of all $\lambda \in \C$ such that $T - \lambda I$ is not invertible.^[ short footnote test]
:::

## Computations and Environments

We can write[^long-test] natively by wrapping `aligned` inside `$$`:

[^long-test]: long footnote test

$$\begin{aligned}
\norm{T x}^2 &= \inner{Tx}{Tx} \\
             &= \inner{T^* T x}{x}
\end{aligned}$$ {#eq-star}

As seen in @eq-star, we can reference tagged equations seamlessly

::: {#def-hilbert}
## Hilbert Space

A Hilbert space $H$ is a complete inner product space with an inner product $\inner{x}{y}$.
:::

## Spectral Theorem
